body:
The owner's decisions of 2026-11-17 (#665 issuecomment-6939460730 and issuecomment-6939574513) replace repeated sync rounds with batched merges: two positive reviews per PR at its own head, freeze, one composition, one composition review, one full candidate on the composed tree, one merge.

Record this as standing process:
- a new CONTRIBUTING.md section 2.3 "Batched merges";
- pointers and amendments in CONTRIBUTING.md 2.1, AGENTS.md sections 6, 7 and 8, and docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md (Fast feedback).

**Landing:** on dev now, as docs only. On dev-soft-core as the first unbatched change after the flip train's single merge.

**Follow-up:** after the first batch merge, check that the containment and review-integrity checks judge member PRs marked merged by ancestry.

Relates to #665.

comments.body:
[A795] TAKEN
Branch: docs-batch-merge (from dev 6b66f66d)
Authoritative references: #665 issuecomment-6939460730 and issuecomment-6939574513; CONTRIBUTING.md 2.1 and 2.2; AGENTS.md sections 6, 7 and 8; docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md "Fast feedback".
Interpreted scope: docs only. Add CONTRIBUTING.md section 2.3 "Batched merges" (freeze, batch, compose once, check once, merge once, findings after composition, not batched). Add the batch path to the 2.1 diagram and a batch note to step 7. Add pointers and amendments in AGENTS.md sections 6, 7 and 8, and update the CI_WORKFLOWS "Fast feedback" lines that describe the merge train. No code, test or RTL change.
Validation plan: every docs workflow check on a clean clone of the final head (docs_check, check_doc_style, check_em_dash, gen_toc anchors and contents, check_doc_paths, docs_inventory, check_feature_status and the rest of the docs jobs), all rc 0.
Blockers: none

[A795] REVIEW READY
Commit: 490d54ee (branch docs-batch-merge, on dev 6b66f66d; the manager pushes it and opens the PR)
Changed: docs only, 3 files, +117/-3. CONTRIBUTING.md has a new section 2.3 "Batched merges", the batch path in the 2.1 diagram, and a batch-candidate paragraph in step 7. AGENTS.md has the frozen-PR and composition-review paragraphs in section 6, the composed-batch ledger paragraph and the amended candidate bullet in section 7, and two never-rules in section 8. docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md "Fast feedback" now describes one batch candidate per merge. Every piece is the draft's text, verbatim, at its quoted anchor. The commit's added and removed lines equal the draft's, file by file.
Validation: the five docs workflow jobs (wire-accountability, docs-check-no-git, docs-gates-0/1/2), replayed step by step on a clean clone of 490d54ee: 71 run steps, all rc 0, every job success. The two builder legs and the RV32 SDK install are included. Hosted-only plumbing (evidence upload, the docs-check receipt union, apt resolution) was not run.
- docs_check 0 findings; check_doc_style OK; check_em_dash 0 findings over 117 added lines; gen_toc --check OK; check_doc_paths OK; docs_inventory fresh; check_feature_status 0 findings.
- gen_toc --verify-anchors: 620 cross-page fragment links (617 on dev). The three new ones are CONTRIBUTING.md#23-batched-merges from AGENTS.md (twice) and CI_WORKFLOWS.md.
- Planted mutants: a broken #23-batched-merges fragment in AGENTS.md or CI_WORKFLOWS.md fails gen_toc --verify-anchors ("MISS ... #23-batched-mergez"). A wrong ../CONTRIBUTING.md path fails docs_check ("broken link").
- Both CONTRIBUTING.md flowcharts parse and render.
Acceptance criteria: met. Section 2.3 is added, and the pointers and amendments are in CONTRIBUTING.md 2.1, AGENTS.md sections 6, 7 and 8, and CI_WORKFLOWS "Fast feedback", all on dev as docs only. The head descends directly from the unchanged dev tip, so its tree is the candidate merge tree.
Open risks/questions:
1. No docs gate checks a same-page (#fragment) link: a broken #23-batched-merges inside CONTRIBUTING.md would pass. The new one resolves under gen_toc's anchor walk. This gap needs its own Issue.
2. check_doc_style does not cover these three pages. The new paragraphs in AGENTS.md sections 6 and 7 (29, 40 and 63 words) and the CI_WORKFLOWS block are longer than its audience-doc limits. The draft wording is kept as written; splitting them is a reviewer call.
3. The decisions scope option B to the flip train; standing process rests on the owner's request in #940. Ancestry-merged member PRs are still unproved against check_merge_review_integrity and check_merge_containment --merged-prs (the follow-up #940 records).

[A795] REVIEW READY (round 2; replaces the round-1 REVIEW READY for review)
Commit: ee5c6f92 (branch docs-batch-merge: 490d54ee, then ee5c6f92, on dev 6b66f66d; the manager pushes it and opens the PR)
Changed: docs only, 3 files, +122/-3.
- 490d54ee applies the draft's text at its anchors. CONTRIBUTING.md gets section 2.3 "Batched merges", the batch path in the 2.1 diagram and the step-7 batch note. AGENTS.md gets the section 6 and 7 paragraphs, the amended completion bullet and two section 8 rules. docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md gets "Fast feedback".
- ee5c6f92 splits the three paragraphs over 30 words into short paragraphs, wording and order unchanged. AGENTS.md section 6 went from 40 to 19 + 21 words, section 7 from 63 to 23 + 21 + 19, and the CI_WORKFLOWS block from 70 to 24 + 19 + 27. Ignoring whitespace, the diff from 490d54ee is empty.
- Every new or changed paragraph is now 30 words or fewer (largest 29), and every new bullet 20 or fewer. The draft's standing-process wording is kept, as the owner asked.
Validation: the five docs workflow jobs (wire-accountability, docs-check-no-git, docs-gates-0/1/2), replayed step by step on a clean clone of ee5c6f92: 71 run steps, all rc 0, every job success (the two builder legs and the RV32 SDK install included; the three gate jobs re-run in full after a host restart). Hosted-only plumbing (evidence upload, the docs-check receipt union, apt resolution) was not run.
- docs_check 0 findings; check_doc_style OK; check_em_dash 0 findings over 122 added lines; gen_toc --check OK; check_doc_paths OK; docs_inventory fresh; check_feature_status 0 findings.
- gen_toc --verify-anchors: 620 cross-page fragment links (617 on dev). The three new ones are CONTRIBUTING.md#23-batched-merges from AGENTS.md (twice) and CI_WORKFLOWS.md.
- Planted mutants: a broken #23-batched-merges fragment in AGENTS.md or CI_WORKFLOWS.md fails gen_toc --verify-anchors ("MISS ... #23-batched-mergez"). A wrong ../CONTRIBUTING.md path fails docs_check ("broken link").
- Both CONTRIBUTING.md flowcharts render (the file is unchanged since 490d54ee).
Acceptance criteria: met. Section 2.3 is added, and the pointers and amendments are in CONTRIBUTING.md 2.1, AGENTS.md sections 6, 7 and 8, and CI_WORKFLOWS "Fast feedback", all on dev as docs only. The head descends directly from the unchanged dev tip, so its tree is the candidate merge tree.
Open risks/questions:
1. No docs gate checks a same-page (#fragment) link: a broken #23-batched-merges inside CONTRIBUTING.md would pass. The new one resolves under gen_toc's anchor walk. This gap needs its own Issue.
2. Member PRs marked merged by ancestry are not yet proved against check_merge_review_integrity and check_merge_containment --merged-prs. #940 records this as a follow-up after the first batch merge.

title: Record the batched-merge process in CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md
